tei:div.tei:p: "$ (69)༄༅// rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so/// /

(70)༄༅// oṃ na mo gu ru he badz+ra gu h+ya sa mā dzaḥtsa kra saṃ bha ra ma hā mā yā badz+ra bhai ra ba ma hā kā la maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ// mthar thug ston pa rnam pa lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi sgrub thabs man ngag bzhin// gsal por 'god la spro ba skyes// dgyes mdzad rdo rje drag po gdan can gyi bskyed pa'i rim pa la gzhi byas nas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa'i tshul ni 'di yin te/ skyabs 'gro ni/ /bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams (71)cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo// chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum (72)mam bdun nam nyer gcig /sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya// de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das yi dam rgyud sde lnga yi bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ lan gsum/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

rus pa'i rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thor pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyis ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa taṣ+ṭhi/ dṛ dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba ka rma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥ(73)ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ /mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam mo// oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa// de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang gi snying gar thim nas zhu ba'i thig le las/ bdag nyid dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang dbang phyug gi gdan la gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ de las khro bo bcu spros phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni// shar du gshin rje gshed nag po tho ba 'dzin pa/

lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po rdo rje gdengs pa (74)'dzin pa/ shar lhor gtum po nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal sngo dmar lcags kyu 'dzin pa// nub byang du be con sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du stobs po che nag po tri shul 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ mi g.yo 'dod rgyal gnod mdzes rnams rol pa'i khro bo// gzhan rnams shin tu khros pa/ thams cad kyang stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ khro bo'i mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa me dpung dang bcas pa'o// khro bo bcu las khro bo bcu lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa phyogs bcur spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams kyi yan lag lnga zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus snying gar btab ste bkug par gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ pradz+nyān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐/ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐/ oṃ nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā ba la hūm̐/ oṃ tsakra wā rta hūm̐/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛ h+ṇa pā ya gṛ h+ṇa pā ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bi d+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yang hūm̐ las phur bu dang tho ba bcu spros/ yang sprul khro bo rnams kyi lag pa g.yas g.yon du gtad/ bgegs rnams kyi (75)spyi bor phur bus btab cing tho bas brdungs pas/ lus g.yo 'gul med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ sems 'od gsal du thim zhing lhag ma rnams rdo rje'i me 'od dang sngags kyi sgras khor yug chen po'i phyi rol du bskrad par gyur// oṃ gha gha gha ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba du ṣ+ṭā na phaṭa/ kī lā ya kī lā ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la badz+ra dha ro ā dz+nya pa ya ti sarba bigh+nā na kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra kī la ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang nyid mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas mā ma kī la 'khyud pa/ /rlung kha sbyar bya/ rtsa gsum gsal btab nas/ a wa dhū ti rab tu rgyas pa'i nang gi snying gar hūm̐ mthing nag /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las ri chad de 'og tu nyi mar gyur/ yang hūm̐ gcig chad do/ de'i steng bu sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur pa ni/ shar gyi rwa gsum dkar po/ lho'i rwa gsum ser po/ nub kyi rwa gsum dmar po/ byang gi rwa gsum ljang gu/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje de nyid rgya che zhing rngams 'thug par gyur pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug tu 'phros pa dpangs mtho bas rwa ba/ rtse mo rnams steng du 'dus par gur dang bla bre/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ phyogs bzhir dmigs nas hūm̐ bzhi pa lan gcig brjod/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gis (76)'od zer gyis sne la rdo rje rtse gcig pa nas rtse dgu pa'i bar gyi rdo rje rnams 'phrog te go mtshams med par gtams/ yar rak+ṣa'i sngags brjod pas/ 'og gi nyi ma las ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi me 'bar bas/ phyi rol kyi rdo rje rnams khro chu ltar zhu nas/ me long gi ngos bzhin du gyur pas bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang mi thar zhing bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i srung 'khor ye shes kyi me 'bar bas dpag tshad bye ba tsam du khyab par gyur/ badz+ra rak+ṣa'i sngags lan gsum brjod/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ bla med dkon mchog rnams gsum// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// khro bo chos skyong bcas pa la// rtag tu gus pas skyabs su mchi/

/lan gsum/ bla ma yi dam 'khor bcas kyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sems can gyi don du rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs bsgrub pa ni shin tu legs so// rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bar chad nga yis bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab par bya'o// zhes gsungs nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bkrus par gyur/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje la sogs pa byon nas rang dang dbyer med du gyur/ oṃ āṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṃ gor+dha ke shartam ne/ (77)tsa turbiṃ sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzi mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ne kan+dha ri ṇe/ adh+ma ta kru ra tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhe n+du daṃṣ+ṭi ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rā na/ ban dha ban dha/ nā ga aṣ+ṭe ka na/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ shā truṃ/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hi/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rika hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥhṝḥhū ྃphaṭa swā hā/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥbi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes rtsa sngags kyis kha bkrus la bdud rtsi myong*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gi pha ma yin/ pha ma 'di rnams sdug bsngal ba snying re rje/ da ni bdag gis bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya// sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang thal bar bya/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi go 'phang la bzhag par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bgyi'o// de nas rang skad cig gis dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas par gsal ba'i snying gar raṃ las steng du hūm̐/

de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pas/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad sbyangs/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin (78)du gyur/ yang 'phros pas sha khrag la sogs pa bar gyi dngos po rnams kyang sbyangs te ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ yang 'phros pa ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir song ste rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkyil 'khor lnga'i lha tshogs bla mas dbu brgyan pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs// bdag gi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā he badz+ra gu h+ya sa mā dzaḥtsakra sam+ba ra ma hā yā badz+ra bhai ra ba maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ sogs sh+tso ka gcig /bcom ldan dgyes mdzad dkyil 'khor dang*// gsang 'dus ma hā mā yā dang*// bde mchog 'khor lo 'jigs byed de// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong tshogs dang bcas pa la// bdag sogs gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā he badz+ra gu h+ya sa mā dzaḥtsakra sam+ba ra ma hā mā yā badz+ra bhai ra ba maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri bā ra ār+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ ste chu gnyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shap+da 'i bar 'bul/ /dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag (79)ma// gha sma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka si ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod mi ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyi ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /de nas rgyun bshags ni/

bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis// bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi// tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo// bla ma rgyud sde'i lha rnams kyis// sems can rgyud la gang 'tsham pa'i// gang 'dul de la der bstan nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// bla ma yi dam lha tshogs kyis// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas dag la ma 'khod par// de srid du ni bzhugs su gsol// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do// (80)bdag gi dge ba'i las ni 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal gcir las sgrol bar shog /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas la// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum ni// ltos med sems can don du 'bul// khyod kyi sku gsum 'grub par shog /de nas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' po rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// dus ni 'di nas bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bzur bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re (81)bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/

/ces pas rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba yang bya'o/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ// stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma la hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ a las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdongs ka che ba gyen du phyogs shing*/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa'i nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla (82)gam yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa// de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ dang 'bar bas mtshan pa// de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po baṃ dang bum pas mtshan pa// de'i steng laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi laṃ dang rdo rjes mtshan pa// de'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu drug pa lte ba la bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'i steng du// rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa// de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu las drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa la sogs pa du ma dpyangs pa// de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i shar bu'i phreng ba dang*// steng du mda' yab mchod rten gyi dbyibs can gyis bskor ba'i bar bar na gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sog pas brgyan pa// nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa// steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhi mig mang ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa// dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog (83)gis spras pa// rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'gram stegs mchod pa'i snam bu dmar po la bud med sgyu ma'i mdzes sdug gis sgeg pa'i gzungs ma rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa// zur bzhir zla phyed nor bu dang*// sgo 'khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa// sgo bzhi'i mdun du rgyan dang bcas pa'i ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs mchod rten gyi rnam pa can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa// rta babs kyi rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos 'khor// steng du gdugs dkar po// g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa// gzhan yang rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gzhal yas khang glang rgyab kyi nang de bzhin gshegs pa lngas mdzes pa/

sgo bzhi'i phyi rol du rin po che'i them skas dang*/ de'i pha rol du bab zhon gyi rta babs dang bcas pa'o// de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag /lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa mi zad pa/ nub byang du ca co (84)sgrog pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa'o// shing chen po brgyad ni/ ha ra tsu ta a sho ka /a shwad tha dang ka rañdza// dza la ti dang par ti pa// bhe ta dang ni bha ṭa'o// rtsa bar phyogs skyong brgyad gnas pa// shar du brgya byin lhor gshin rje// chu lha nub dang gnod sbyin byang*// byang shar 'byung po shar lho me// lho nub srin po nub byang rlung*// mkha' la lha chen brgyad gnas pa// shar du dbang po lhor tshangs pa// khyab 'jug nub dang dbang phyug byang*// byang shar la sogs mtshams bzhi ru// gdong drug tshogs kyi bdag po dang*// bhṛṃ gi ri ti legs ldan nag /chu la klu chen brgyad gnas pa// 'jog po dung skyong rigs ldan dang*// mtha' yas pad chen dga' bo dang*// nor rgyas bu dang pad+ma'o// shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong rnams phyogs skyong so so'i mdog dang mtshungs shing so so'i bzhon pa'i gdong pa can gri gug dang thod pa gtor mas gang ba 'dzin pa'o// sprin chen po brgyad ni// sgrog byed ser po// ldog byed sngon po/ 'jigs byed dkar po// 'khor byed ser po// 'thug po dkar po// 'gegs byed dmar pa/ char 'bebs nag po// gtum po ljang gu'o// gzhan yang ri brgyad// mchod rten brgyad/ chu brgyad/ drag (85)tu 'bar ba'i me brgyad bcas pa// gzhan yang ro dang ro langs dang sha ma dang 'byung po dang srin po dang*/ bya dang gcan gzan dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma grub pa thob pa dang*/ grub pa'i rdzas dang mchod rdzas thams cad kyis gang ba dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod/

de rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser// nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ phyogs bzhi dmar ba/ me dang rlung ser ba/ bden bral ljang ba/ dbang ldan sngo ba// mtha' ma rdo rje nag po'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba/ lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po// dbang po kham ser/ nye dbang ljang gu/ drag po thal kar rnams gan rkyal du bkram pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du tshangs pa/ lho ru brgya byin/ nub tu nye dbang*/ byang du drag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor gnod sbyin ser po/ lho nub tu srin po smug nag /nub byang du lha min thags bzang ris ljang gu rnams gan rkyal du gnas pa'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ sgo bzhi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yi dwags kyi gdan re re'o// dbus su rang sems hūm̐ dang (86)i nag po/ de'i 'og tu mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo// ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ṭa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ṭa ḍha da dha la ya// phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du yi ge gnyis zhugs te/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang aṃ las gri gug aṃ gis mtshan par gyur pa ni so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rgyu rdo rje'i 'dzin pa sku mdog mthing nag

/zhal brgyad pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ spro ba/ lha dang lha min thams cad sdigs par mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs pa/ drag po chen po rtsa ba'i zhal nag po// g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba steng zhal du ba'i mdog can/ lhag (87)ma zhal bzhi nag pa/ dbu skra ser po 'bar zhing 'khyil ba/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thod skam lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan can smin ma yon po dang bcas shing*/ khro gnyer ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ban+dhu ltar dmar po'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ral gri// gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na 'khor lo/ lnga pa na bshor/ drug pa na dbyug pa/ bdun pa na rtse gsum// brgyad pa na lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na kha ṭ+waṃ ga /lnga pa na thod pa/ drug pa na rin po che/ bdun pa ni sdigs mdzub/ brgyad pa na zhags pa bsnams pa/ sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can// gcer bu zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang gi stabs dang*/ rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis tshangs pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ drag po dang*/ nye dbang rnams mnyam par mnan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ snying rje rngams dang zhi ba ste// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ de la 'khyud pa'i bdag med ma nag mo drag mo chen mo lha mo'i cha byad (88)rdzogs pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang mgo bo skam po lnga'i phreng ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rjes su chags pa/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing nam mkha'i mtha' klas par 'od kyis khyam par mdzad pa 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'o// yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

oṃ badz+ra ma hā de ṣa tsa tur ā nan+ta dā ya ka kha kha mu kha e ka ra so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar aṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma su khā dha rā ma hā rā ga su khaṃ da da tsa tu ra ā nan bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs yab kyi zhal nas zhugs nas thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pas thig le cha bcu gnyis su gyur/ nam mkha' dang nas phyir spros te so so'i gdan la 'khod pa nyi zla kha sbyor bcu gnyis su gyur/ de rnams kyi bar du gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ baṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ dzaḥ(89)hūm̐ baṃ hoḥrnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gri gug dang cang te'u ral gri dang thod pa rin po che dang rdo rje rlung ras dang thod pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa lcags sgrog dang dril bu rnams sa bon de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ zla nyi so so dang gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du go rī nag mo g.yas gnyis gri gug dang mda'// g.yon gnyis thod pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ lhor tso rī dmar mo g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub tu bai tā li ser mo g.yas gnyis ral gri dang chang bum/ g.yon gnyis dung chos dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du gha sma ri ljang gu g.yas gnyis thod zhags dang skyabs sbyin/ g.yon gnyis dgra s+t+wa dang me thab 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka ser sngon mo g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor sha ba rī dkar mo g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga /g.yon gnyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍa lī sngon mo g.yas gnyis rlung ras dang thod pa/

g.yon gnyis pa dan dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub byang du ḍoṃ bi nī sna tshogs mdog g.yas gnyis thod pa dang (90)gshor/ g.yon gnyis mdung rtse gsum dang sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ shar sgor rta gdong ma nag mo zhal bzhi nag ser dmar ba'i steng na rta gdong ljang gu rtsa phyag gnyis kyis gling bu/ tha ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo zhal bzhi ser sngo dkar ba'i steng na phag gdong dmar mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis pi wang*/ tha ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo zhal bzhi dmar sngo dkar ba'i steng na khyi gdong ser mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rnga bo che/ tha ma gnyis kyis pad+ma dang lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor seng gdong ma ljang gu zhal bzhi ljang nag dmar ba'i steng na seng gdong dkar mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rna cha/ tha ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzis pa/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu ma brgyan cig /skam po lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// sgo ma rnams ni sbom thung cher khros shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can no// de nas gtso bo'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ(91)thugs kar hūm̐/ gtsug tor dang lte bar hoḥdamar po ris mtshan par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas bdud bzhi'i steng du/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo'i rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin thig le gnyis su gyur/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i lha mo bzhi'i snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i don la bskul ba ni/ puk+ka sīs// rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs// stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod// sha ba rīs// khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas// dgyes mdzad rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig

/stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod// tsaṇ+ḍa līs/ dga' gtso 'jig rten don gnyer ba// stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci// khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas// gdol ba mo bdag zhu ba bgyid// ḍā+oṃ bi nī sa/ bdag gis nyid kyi thugs 'tshal gyi// mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyed bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces bskul bas thig le gnyis po gcig tu 'dres te nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su hūm̐ dang aṃ las rdo rje (92)dang gri gug hūm̐ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag sogs rgyu rdo rje'i 'dzin pa yum bcas ltar gsal btab bo/ /de ltar bdag nyid dgyes mdzad du gyur pa'i sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i thugs kyi snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa'i lte ba la nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan// 'dab ma rnams la shar du tshangs pa/ lhor dbang po/ nub tu nye dbang*/ byang du drag po/ byang shar du gshin rje/ shar lhor nor bdag /lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du thags bzang ris// dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag /zhal brgyad pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal nas hūm̐ spro ba/ lha dang lha min thams cad sdigs par mdzad pa/ drag po chen rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba steng zhal du ba'i mdog can/ lhag ma zhal bzhi nag pa/ dbu skra ser po 'bar zhing 'khyil ba/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thod skam lnga (93)lnga'i dbu rgyan can smin ma yon po dang bcas shing*/

khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ban+dhu ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa brgyad na/ glang po che/ rta/ bong bu/ glang*/ rnga mo/ mi/ sha ra bha/ byi la rnams so// g.yon pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo/ chu lha/ me lha/ rlung lha/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ gshin rje/ gnod sbyin rnams so// sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa// khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can// gcer bu zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang gi stabs dang*/ rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung byed pa li stabs kyis tshangs pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ drag po dang*/ nye dbang rnams mnyam par mnan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa/ de la 'khyud pa'i bdag med ma nag mo drag mo chen mo lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang*/ mgo bo skam po'i phreng ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis chags pa/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs shing*// gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin (94)pa/ lhor chom rkun ma dmar mo g.yas ḍā ma ru g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu ro langs ma ser mo g.yas ru sbal g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du za nus ma ljang gu g.yas sbrul g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du spos mo sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol ba mo sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga ldan// g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo dkar po 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i steng du/
dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i sku'i snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dbus le

nga tshe dgu pa snam bu rim pa gnyis dang bcas pa/ dbus dang khro bcu'i gnas su nyi gdan/ shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma kī la rdo rje/ gzhan lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po// byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje'i (95)gdan/ dbus su mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa// dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khyud rgyas yum reg bya rdo rje ma rang dang 'dra ba pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ re mig rnams la shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje pad dkar/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu nor bu ral gri 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo// g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu pad ser ral gri 'dzin pa// nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dang po dril bu dkur bsten pas pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yas kyi dang pos kha 'byed pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du don grub ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi (96)g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma ki sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo ut+pal sngo dmar/

g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dang po dril bu dkur bsten pas ut+pal dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yas kyi dang pos kha 'byed pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo// g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo ut+pal sngon pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin che ral gri 'dzin pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo sangs rgyas spyan ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis me long dmar po 'dzin (97)pa/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo mā ma ki dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis pi wang sngon po 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma ljang gu sgrol ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ro drug gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ rim pa gsum pa'i lha snam la/ shar sgo g.yas su byams pa rnam snang 'dra ba las/ g.yas kyi dang pos klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon du sa'i snying po rnam snang dang 'dra ba/ lho sgo'i g.yas su phyag rdo rje dang g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu/ nub sgo'i g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ g.yon du 'jam dpal 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba// byang sgo'i g.yas su sgrib pa rnams sel dang*/ g.yon du kun tu bzang po don po don grub lta bu/ lha yab rnams thams cad ral pa'i thor tshugs dang mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa/ yum rnams dbu skra phyed bcings su byas pa// sgeg cing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/

zur gyis lta ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis (98)mdzes pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i dga' bas rol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung dang*/ gzhan rnams sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ thams cad dar gyi na bza' dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o// shar sgor gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis tho ba 'khor lo rdo rje// g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis pad+ma ral gri gtun shing*/ g.yon snyems pa dang bcas dril bu dgra s+t+wa zhwags pa 'dzin pa/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing*/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ shar lho'i grwar mi g.yo ba nag po nag dkar (99)dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dgra s+t+wa zhags pa/ lho nub kyi grwar 'dod rgyal sngon mo rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya can/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon zhags pa dang lcags kyu/ nub byang gi grwar dbyug sngon can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po ral gri 'khor lo// g.yon thugs kar zhags pa bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub pad+ma dgra s+t+wa/

byang shar gyi grwa stobs po che sngon po don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po ral gri 'khor lo// g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa rtse gsum dgra s+t+wa/ steng gi ya phugs kyi nang du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje dang pad+ma/ g.yon (100)sdigs mdzub dang ral gri/ 'og tu sa gzhi'i nang du gnod mdzes nag po mi bskyod ba'i dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub pad+ma ral gri khro bo thams cad kyang stobs chen pha rol gnon pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa// stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ dus mtha'i me lta bu'i me stag 'bar ba dang bcas pas gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'o// mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i steng du/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i gsung gi snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa la sgyu 'phrul chen mo lha lngar gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal he ru ka sngon po sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i zhal phyag dang po gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo dmar ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu/ khro chags sgeg la 'jigs pa'ang (101)'jigs par mdzad pa/ spyan gsum gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba/ skra ser gyen brdzes thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/

rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ phyag rgya lnga dang gar dgus rol pa/ thal chen gyis byugs shing mi lpags kyis stod g.yogs can g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis nyi ma'i steng du mi ro'i snying gar mnan pa me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo// sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rdo rje dril bu kha ṭ+waṃ ga thod pa bsnams pa/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rin chen ce spyang ba dan mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar dmar dkar ser ljang sngo ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis pad+ma thod pa gzhu dang mda' bsnams pa/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis ral gri zhags pa ka pā la ḍā ma ru bsnams pa/ lha mo lnga ni thal ba dang bral ba/ lhag ma gtso mo dang mtshungs pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'o// lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo ser po rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i steng du/ dgyes mdzad (102)rdo rje'i yon tan gyi snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor lo'i mu khyud can/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma'i mu khyud can/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ gsum ka'ang rtsibs brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus su bde chen 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud la gri gug gi phreng ba can/ sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ zhal re re la dmar zhing g.yo ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/

mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags rlon stod g.yogs su gyon pa/ lhag ma g.yas rnams kyis ḍā ma ru dgra sta rtse gsum gri gug /g.yon pa rnams kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa zhags pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams (103)pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ thod skam lnga lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol zhing phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ g.yon khrag chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum drag mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang mgo phreng gis brgyan pa byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ khrag la dgyes shing zla mtshan dang bcas pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma rnams la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo// byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dma' mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo// shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas (104)sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa ste/

sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni ro'i gdan dang bcas pa/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma la bum pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'o// thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs su pul+li ra ma la ya ra kha ṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo// byang phyogs dza lan+dha ra ra ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub phyogs o ḍi ya nar kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho phyogs a rbu ta ra mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ shar lhor go da wa rir su ra bi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub ra smi shwa ra ra 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang di bī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag pa'o// (105)gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs kā ma rū par aṃ ku ri dang ai ra ba ti/ byang phyogs o trer ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo// nub phyogs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lhor ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang sh+yā ma de bī/ lho nub tu laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo// nub byang kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ byang shar hi ma lar mig mi bzang dang khā ṇ+ḍa na ste gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po'o// sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang phyogs gṛ ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hī/ nub phyogs sauraṣ+ṭar rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi ni/ lho phyogs su wa rna dwī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na gā ra dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo// lho nub sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/

nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ byang shar ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab (106)pa'i ngo bo kha dog dkar po'o// dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams dpal he ru ka'i rigs las byung ba he ru ka dang rnam pa mtshungs pa ste/ zhal gcig phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang rang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni rdo rje'i phag mo'i rigs las byung ba phag mo dang rnam pa mtshungs pa ste/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa bsnams pa'o// gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo ljang gu rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi steng du dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i phrin las kyi snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dbus kyi lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje/ steng thog re'u mig dgur phubs pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag sum cu so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa/ rtsa zhal nag po ma he'i gdong can shin tu khros pa/ pheṃ ka ra'i sgra chen po 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ de'i steng na srin po'i zhal dmar po bzhad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ de'i steng na 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po 'dzum zhing cung zad khros pa/ gzhon nu'i (107)rgyan can/ rwa'i g.yas phyogs kyi zhal dang po sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa ser po ste mnga' bdag gi zhal gsum shin tu khros pa/ rwa'i g.yon phyogs kyi zhal dang po dkar po/ gnyis pa dud kha/ gsum pa nag po ste zhal gsum ka'ang gtsigs pa'o// khros zhal rnams smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag bcu drug gis rim pa bzhin du/ gri gug 'phang mdung gtun shing chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig pa dgra s+t+wa mdung mda' lcags kyu dbyug pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'khor lo rdo rje rtse lnga pa rdo rje tho ba ral gri rde'u chung bsnams pa/

g.yon pa'i phyag bcu drug gis rim pa bzhin du/ thod khrag tshangs pa'i mgo bo phub zlum rkang pa rdo rje'i zhags pa gzhu rgyu ma rdo rje dril bu lag ba ro ras skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa me thab thod tshal sdigs mdzub 'phan rtse gsum pa rlung ras bsnams pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ phyag dang po gnyis phyag mtshan thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin cing 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o// zhabs bcu drug (108)gi g.yas brgyad bskum pas rim pa bzhin du mi dang ma he dang glang dang bong bu dang rnga mo dang khyi dang lug dang wa rnams mnan pa/ g.yon brgyad brkyang bas rim pa bzhin du bya rgod dang 'ug pa dang khra dang bya rog dang ne tso dang khyung dang ri skeg dang bzhad rnams mnan pa/ de rnams kyi 'og tu tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams bskyel zhing kha sbub tu mnan pa/ dbu re re la thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ rak+ta'i thig le/ zhag gi zo ris rnams kyis mtshan pa/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na sum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba/ g.yon khrag chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum drag mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ gcer bu skra ser 'khyil ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang rlon bral gyi mgo phreng gis cod pan dang do shal du brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis yab la 'khril ba/ khro mo'i (109)cha lugs rdzogs pa/ 'od kyis nam mkha'i mthar khyab pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o// shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing*/

lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri// g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang (110)thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis rin po dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ shar lhor tsar tsi ka dkar mo gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu/ lho nub tu phag mo ser mo dbu'i steng du phag zhal gyen du lta ba dang bcas pa ser sna gshin rje gshed lta bu/ nub byang du dbyangs can ma dmar mo 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu/ byang shar du gau ri ljang gu phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu/ de ltar lha mo bzhi po rang snang gi thabs la 'khyud pa'o/ shar sgor tho ba gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho sgor dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ nub sgor pad+ma gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag (111)drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/

lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ byang sgor ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ 'khor rnams thams cad rgyan dang cha lugs bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa ste/ 'on kyang lha mo bzhi ni bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis bsgying ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa las g.yon brkyang gi stabs can no// phyi'i grwa bzhir ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o// rang dgyes mdzad rdo rje mtshon cha can gyi thugs kar pad nyi la hūm̐/ lha mo bcu gsum gyi thugs kar pad zla la/ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrnams 'khod par gyur/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ shar phyogs kyi dur khrod chen po'i (112)thad kyi steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs/ oṃ bha ga wā na ma hā kā ru ṇi kā he badz+ra gu h+ya sa mā dzaḥtsa kra sam+ba ra ma hā mā yā badz+ra bhai ra ba maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri bā ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis yang dag par mchod pa ni phyi mchod do// spro na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs la 'bul/ bsdu na/ dgyes mdzad la oṃ de ba pi tsu sogs snying po lan gnyis dang*/ gtso bo gzhan bzhi'i oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛ ka dang oṃ āḥhrīḥ dang oṃ hrīḥha ha dang oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi sogs snying po lan re brjod la/ mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ de thams cad kyang sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med par shes par byas nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra be tā le ban+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gha sma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan lnga/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dam tshig sems dpa' ro gcig tu gyur/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i lha thams cad mig tu moṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo// rna bar daṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma dmar mo/ sna la maṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo// kha la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar iṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma (113)ljang gu lte bar noṃ las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo// de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje ma drug gi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te skye mched kyi lha rnams la thim/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi lus sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/ oṃ la thim pa las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo// mgrin par āḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi ngag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/

āḥl thim pa las gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo// thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi yid kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te hūm̐ la thim pa las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo// lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa dang mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o// rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer sna lnga pa 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab (114)yum// khro bo rig ma dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod pa gsum gyis mchod/ /zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rje bdag la stsol// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po khyod// las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur// bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs ka nas phyung pa'i spyan ma dang*/ mā ma kī dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma rnams kyis byang chub kyis sems kyis gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams kyis bsrung ba'i las mdzad byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blang*/ rdo rje ma rnams kyis mchod do// dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad la dbang (115)bskur/

chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las gtso bo yab yum dang*/ gau rī dang*/ puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha ba rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā li dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ gha sma rī dang ḍoṃ bi nī la 'od dpag med rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ sgo ma bzhi la don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po stong gsum gyi khyon tsam gyi nang du/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūm̐ las snabs dang mchil ma/ shar du bh+rūṃ las dri chen/ lhor aṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+riṃ las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du khaṃ las dri chu/ dbus su na las mi'i sha /byang shar du gaṃ las ba lang gi sha /shar lhor nāṃ las glang po che'i sha /lho nub tu haṃ las rta'i sha /nub byang du ṣaṃ las ce sbyang gi sha rnams kyis gang ba/ steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sna bug nas thon/ rlung gi ba dan la phog /yaṃ (116)las rlung g.yos/ raṃ las me sbar/ thod pa'i rdzas rnams bskol/ zhu zhing gyen du lud pas mi gtsang ba rnams phyir byung*/ steng gi āḥzla ba'i dkyil 'khor hūm̐ rdo rjer gyur pa oṃ dang bcas te thod par lhung bas rdzas rnams lan bdun du dkrugs shing sbyang*/ yang rdo rje 'greng bur gnas pa'i lte bar āḥlas byung ba'i zla ba la hūm̐ dang rtse mo la oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang

ha ho hrīḥ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs shing gsol bas tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas sngar bzhin ār+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ// lha mo'i 'khor gyis bcom ldan bskor// rgyu dang mi rgyu khyod kyi thugs// sems can kun gyi don mdzad rnams// bcom ldan mchog tu dgyes rdo rje// zhal mdzes thugs kyi dgongs pa 'grub// thugs dgyes mdzad cig dgyes rdo rje// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ// hūm̐ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes (117)che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo// thams cad dngos po rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad rang bzhin gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// kyai rdo rjer bdag phyag 'tshal// mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che// sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal// bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me dpung lta bu rab 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal// sku la gzi brjid phyag stong ldan pa po// dgra sta zhabs pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa sku la gsol// sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// bka' yi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// bdud dang mu stegs lha min bcom// gshin rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la sngags 'di rnams bzla bar bya ste/ oṃ aṣ+ḍā na nā ya/

piṃ gor+bha ke sha wartam ne/ tsa tu rbiṃ sha ti ni trā ya// ṣo ḍa (118)sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzi mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ne kan+dha ri ṇe/ adh+ma ta kru ra tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhā+en+du daṃṣ+ṭī ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ka ra ya ka ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rā na/ ban dha ban dha/ nā ga aṣ+ṭa kān/ gṛ h+na gṛ h+na/ shā truṃ/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri he badz+ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ aṃ swā hā/ de ni mtshon cha can gyi'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛ ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥspar+sha badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdzi n-i dzaka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhi ka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ā ro l̥ ka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyādhṛ ka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmo hā rā ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa rā ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrā ga rā ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥru pa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshab+da badz+rā hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgan+dha badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥr sa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥme hūm̐/ oṃ āḥthadhīṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ ā ཿya mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥprādz+nyān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpad+man+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥṭāk+ki rā dzā hūm̐/ (119)oṃ āḥnī la dan+ḍa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm hā ba la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥtsakra wa rti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsuṃ bha rā dzā hūm̐/ de ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'o/ /oṃ āḥhrīḥhū ྃphaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī āḥhrī hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki ni āḥhrī hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/

de ni ma hā mā ya'i 'o/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥgaṃ hū ྃswā hā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥpaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥshaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ de ni mtshon cha'i lha dgu'i yin no/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dzā la saṃ bha raṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra bar+ṇa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ pu dza o a go ra de ma/ ka o tri kro ka ma ga he/ pre gri sau su na si ma ku/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes bde mchog gi sngags phreng bsdus pa'o// rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥdhīḥswā hā/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥbi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥdzi n-i dzaka (120)hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a ro l̥ka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmo ha rā ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa rā ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrā ga rā ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmuṅga ra dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdan+ḍa dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpad+ma dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkhaḍ+ga dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥṇa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥyo hūm̐/ oṃ āḥni hūm̐/ oṃ āḥr hūm̐/ ces pa ni rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs kyi yin no// rgyas par na mtshon cha can la/ phreng ba'i sngags 'di dag bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ye sid+dhi pa ra ma yo gi shwa ri ka pā la mā la dha ri ṇi ru dhi ra pri yesh+ma shā na pā si nī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍe shwa ri/ kha ṭ+wāṅgi ma hā badz+ri ṇī ka pā la mā la/

mu ku ṭo ā ka d+dha/ sarba duṣ+ṭa da pa mā kaṭ+ṭa/ ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ra dzi te pa ra ma gu h+ye ka pā la mā lā ni bhū te sarba duṣ+ṭa mo ha ni pre ye h+ye hi bha ga ba ti badz+ra gu h+ye shwa rī/ ba hu bi dha be sha dha ra ṇi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa ni pā ra ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra be tā li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa bi kṛ te be ṣa dha ri ṇi/ bi kṛ tā laṅka ra bhā ṣe te ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā bi lam+pa mā bi lam+pa/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra pra be sha ya maṇ+ḍa la ma dh+ye/ ut+tha ba ya sarba hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga ba ti badz+ra gu h+ye shwa ri pa hu bi dha bi sha dha ri ṇ-i/ sarba ta thā ga ta (121)duṣ+ṭa sa mā ya ma nu sma ra ha na ha na/ raṅga raṅga/ raṅga pā ya raṅga pā ya/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha/ sarba bhu ta na rtan rta/ nartā pa ya nartā pa ya/ haḥha ha ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shū la a graṃ bhin+da bhin+da sarba duṣ+ṭa hṛ da yaṃ/ ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ nirma tha nirma tha/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ mā bi lam+ba mā bi lam+ba/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma he shwa ri/ haṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ haṃḥru lu ru lu/ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhak+ṣa la sarba duṣ+ṭan ni rma tha hri da yaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sum+bha ni dī p+ta sa ma ya badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ba ḍa bā mu kha yo ge shwa rī hīḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐ dzaḥ.oṃ badz+ra bā rā hī mu khī tri baṃ pa hūm̐/ oṃ tsan+d+ra sū r+ya hu tā sha ni siṃ ha ni rnā de siṃ ha ni rnā de siṃ ha bak+t+re siṃ hi ni ṭāṃ ṭāṃ baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhā ru dzī ba ni ma hā yak+ṣa ṇī shwa ni ru pi nī ma hā prā la ya ni rnā dā+e kā ma ru pi nī trāṃ tra ṭa ṭa ho/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig tsam gyis grub par gyur/

bzlas pa'i skabs su bstan pa ltar sngags re re'i mthar/ a kā ro sgyur ba gtso bo rnams la lan bdun bdun/ 'khor rnams la re re phul la/ gong du ye shes pa la mchod pa 'bul (122)ba ltar phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ rang rang gi bstod pas kyang bdag bskyed ltar bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la zhes sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la bar 'dir gtor ma 'bul/ de nas spyi gtor ni/ /gzhal yas khang thad chos 'byung la// paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad sngo// lte bar bcom ldan thugs rdo rje// iṃ yaṃ bāṃ yaṃ bhaṃ raṃ naṃ pāṃ rnams las// shar du brgya byin lhor gshin rje// chu lha nub dang gnod sbyin byang*// byang shar 'byung po shar lho me// lho nub srin po nub byang rlung*// mi dang gnod sbyin sogs kyis bskor// gzhal yas khang steng chos 'byung la// paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar// lte bar bcom ldan sku rdo rje// shāṃ oṃ biṃ ruṃ kaṃ gaṃ bh+ri kaṃ rnams las// shar du dbang po shar lhor tshangs pa// khyab 'jug nub dang dbang phyug byang*// byang shar la sogs mtshams bzhi ru// gdong drug tshogs kyi bdag po dang*// bhṛṃ gi ri ti legs ldan nag /'dod pa'i lha la sogs pas bskor// gzhal yas khang 'og chos 'byung la// paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar// lte bar bcom ldan gsung rdo rje// phuṃ pheṃ phuṃ pheṃ pho phu phīṃ phai rnams las// shar du dga' bo dung skyong lho// nub tu mtha' yas byang rigs ldan// byang shar pad chen (123)'jog po me// srin por nor rgyas pad+ma rlung*/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gros bskor// 'byung po'i gtso bo nyer bzhi po// rang rang bu smad g.yog 'khor bcas// mkha' dbyings gang ba'i 'byung po rnams// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis med thim// thams cad rang mdog thig ler zhu// dbus ma'i thams cad mi bskyod pa// steng gi thams cad rnam snang mdzad// 'og ma'i thams cad 'od dpag med// rang snang shes rab dam pas 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa dang*// g.yas brkyang bzhugs shing dur khrod brgyan// snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer gyis// ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs gyur// gau rī dzaḥtsau rī hūm̐/
be tā lī baṃ/ ghasma rī hoḥ mig tu moṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma/

zhes pa nas/ shri ye hūm̐/ dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las/ sa spyod kyi rigs la mi bskyod pa/ mkha' spyod kyi rigs la rnam snang*/ sa 'og spyod pa'i rigs la 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan te thams cad kyang chags bral gyi cha byad can no// oṃ i na da/ dzam dza la/ dzak+kha bhu ta/ ba h+ni bā u/ rak+kha/ tsan+d+ra/ sudz+dza/ mā ta bap+pa ta la/ pa tā la/ at+ṭha sa p+pa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuṃ dza/ dzi gha/ phul+la dhu pa maṃ sa biṃ gha/ aṃ ba/ (124)sap+pa/ kadz+dza mā ta khaṇ+ḍa khu ṇi phe ḍa ga ta/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ā d+ya nudapan+na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin pā d+yaṃ dang*/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ /mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror= /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// mi rtog nam mkha' dri ma med// dngos 'dzin dag pas gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gror= /rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad+ma mkha' 'gror= /rdo rje dag pa 'don mi za// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong la// bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i gtor ma dang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// rnal 'byor bdag (125)cag 'khor bcas dang*// mtha' yas sems can ma lus la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// yon tan phrin las rgyas par shog /kol+la i reṭaṭha a bol+la// mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko la// gha ṇa i ki paṃ ṭa ho badz+dza i// ka ru ṇi ka a i ṇa ro lā/

ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dza i// gā ḍeṃ ma a ṇā bidz+dza a i// ha le kā liñdza ra pa ṇi a i// dun+du ra badz+dza a i// tsa u sa ma ka s+thu ri sih+lā// kaspu ra lā i a i// ma lā i in+dha ṇa sā liṃ dzaṃ a i// ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i// phreṅkha ṇa khi ṭa ka ran+te// shud+dha a shud+dha ṇa ma ṇa a i// ni rang+shu āṅge tsa ḍā bi a i// ta hiṃ dza sa ra ba ād+da pa ṇi a i// ma la a dze kun+tu ru bā ḍā i// ḍiṇ+ḍi ma ta heṃ ṇa badz+dza a i/ /zhes rdo rje'i glu blangs/ /oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ sogs sh+tso ka gsum gyi bkra shis brjod/ /skye zhing skye bar rigs mchog tu// skye zhing khengs med dam tshig ldan// dgyes mdzad rdo rje ston pa dang*// brtse ldan bla mar gus 'gyur shog /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba len par shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi (126)lam nas 'gro ba yi// lam de myur du grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis sgrol// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la// da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces smon lam btab// yi ge brgya pas nyams chags bskang*/ /ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod// lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang*// cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang*// bdag gis brjed ngas ci mchis pa// de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod// bag med spyod pa ma dag pas// rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin// ma lcogs 'khrul pa ci mchis pa// de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces brjod par gsol la/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/

/zhes snyan mnan/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bdag nyid la thim/ oṃ muḥgats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wa nāṃ/ zhes 'jig rten pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang sgom pa'i (127)dkyil 'khor yang skad cig gis mi snang bar gyur te 'od gsal ba'i ngo bo'o// stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis par gyur// dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ snang ba thams cad lha'i 'khor lor gyur/ slar yang smon lam btab ste thun mtshams la 'jug go /de ltar dgyes mdzad lha bcu gsum ma la brten nas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor kyis chabs cig tu bsgom pa'i tshul la lugs gzhan kyi bsre bslad med par bshad zin to// grub chen bye ba'i thugs kyi bcud// rdo rje 'chang gi lam bzang mchog /khyung po'i mtshan 'chang grub brnyes de'i// dgongs pa ji bzhin gsal bar bkod// ces pa dpal rgyud sde lnga'i sgrub thabs ngag 'don 'di tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o// shu bha ma stu sarba dza ga ti/// /(128)
